working_definition_ja: レースで馬が負担する騎手・鞍等を含む規定上の重量。
notes: P0-SRC-022;P0-SRC-024. JRA defines carried weight as rider plus saddle/equipment weight; BHA race conditions also use weight carried. Exact included items follow local rules.

working_definition_ja: ハンデキャップ競走で能力評価等に基づき割り当てる負担重量。
notes: P0-SRC-022. JRA explains handicap races as assigning weight according to ability/performance to equalise winning opportunity; calculation systems vary by jurisdiction.

working_definition_ja: 年齢等に応じた所定の重量表に基づく方式。
notes: P0-SRC-023;P0-SRC-024. BHA uses a current WFA scale by age/time of year in conditions races; do not collapse into JRA 馬齢重量 or other regional systems.

working_definition_ja: 所定条件により固定的に負担重量を定める方式。
notes: AUNZ-SRC-005;AUNZ-SRC-006;P1-SRC-007. Current Racing Australia programmes explicitly use Set Weights as a race weight condition; detailed scales are race/PRA-specific.

working_definition_ja: 基本重量に実績等の条件で加増する方式。
notes: P1-SRC-008. Current Racing Australia acceptances explicitly use Set Weights plus Penalties; penalty triggers and scale remain race-condition specific.

working_definition_ja: 資格・年齢・性別等により負担重量を減じる制度・量。文脈で競走種別と区別する。
notes: P0-SRC-023;P0-SRC-025. BHA and JRA both document rider-related weight allowances/reductions; allowance basis and amount are jurisdiction-specific.

working_definition_ja: 見習騎手の騎乗に対して認められる減量。
notes: GBIRE-SRC-004;GBIRE-SRC-005;AUNZ-SRC-002. Current BHA and Racing Victoria material explicitly describe apprentice claims/allowances that reduce carried weight; thresholds vary by jurisdiction.

working_definition_ja: 一定資格の騎手が規定重量から減量を受ける制度。
勝利実績等に応じて追加される負担重量。
notes: P0-SRC-023;P0-SRC-024. BHA conditions-race and handicapping material explicitly applies penalties that increase weight; triggers and amounts vary by race conditions. WEIGHT-010 Weight penalty is retired into this Concept in P1 wave 1.

working_definition_ja: 競走で最も重い負担重量を課された馬。
notes: AUNZ-SRC-002. Racing Victoria current handicapping policy repeatedly uses top weight/topweight for the highest end of a race's weight scale; exact minimum topweight rules are jurisdiction-specific.

working_definition_ja: 競走で最も軽い負担重量を課された馬、またはその最軽量。
notes: BC-SRC-013. An official Racing Australia published form uses bottom weight in race analysis for the lightest end of the handicap scale; retain regional scope rather than asserting a universal official label.

working_definition_ja: 競走条件上認められる最低重量。
notes: AUNZ-SRC-002;P1-SRC-009. Racing Victoria policy and current Racing Australia acceptances explicitly publish minimum weights; values vary by race class and jurisdiction.

working_definition_ja: 競走条件上設定される最大・上限の負担重量。
notes: BC-SRC-010. Current 2026 Racing Australia programmes publish Maximum Weight in race conditions; values and applicability remain race- and jurisdiction-specific.

working_definition_ja: 公式に各馬へ割り当てられた負担重量。
notes: AUNZ-SRC-002;P1-SRC-009. Racing Victoria explains rating-derived assigned weights and Racing Australia publishes each runner's assigned Weight; calculation systems vary by jurisdiction.

working_definition_ja: 前走等と比べて負担重量が増えること。
前走等と比べて負担重量が減ること。
騎手等が規定重量を超えて騎乗する状態・追加重量。
notes: GBIRE-SRC-009. IHRB current non-runner/reserve procedure requires declared rider overweight to be reported before racing; amount and consequences remain rule-specific.

working_definition_ja: 検量で本来負担すべき重量より不足している状態。規則上の扱いは管轄ごとに異なる。
notes: BC-SRC-012. BHA Rules explicitly address disqualification for an underweight rider / horse carrying less weight than required; retain British regulatory scope.

working_definition_ja: 競走前に騎手と装具の重量を確認する手続。
notes: BC-SRC-011. The Jockey Club current glossary directly explains pre-race Weighing Out by official scales and the Clerk of the Scales.

working_definition_ja: 競走後に騎手と装具の重量を確認する手続。
notes: BC-SRC-011;BC-SRC-012. The Jockey Club and BHA rules directly describe post-race weighing in and its role in verifying carried weight and the race result.
